Subject: Trial extension + extra credits for integration testing

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks very promising for our clinician UI. Our security team needs a couple more weeks to finish the on-prem/data-flow review, and procurement has limited runway on the PO side until their next board cycle (early Jan).

We'd like to ask if Redwood can: 1) extend the sandbox by 30 days beyond the standard PLG window, and 2) provide an additional $2,500 in free credits to run a simulated throughput test (we'll exercise long conversations and the KV cache scenarios you suggested).

Best,

Folks — forwarding the ask from Medilumen. High-level: security delay + procurement calendar means they need runway to finish internal approvals. They’re asking for a 30-day extension and $2.5k in credits to run integration/throughput tests.

Why I think it's reasonable:
- Medilumen is a targeted mid-market account in healthcare (good logos + potential for Dedicated)
- They were impressed by our prefix/KV cache gains — the infra side needs to validate at scale
- Probable conversion to a paid PM band in Q1 if tests go well

Suggested guardrails (proposal for exec signoff):
1) 30-day sandbox extension from 11/30/2026 to 12/30/2026 (one-time only)
2) $2,500 complimentary credits, usable only for the sandbox project id HLY-2026-099-sandbox (no refunds)
3) Require a short acceptance form (DocuSign link) acknowledging limited use and no chargebacks.
4) If Medilumen signs a 3-month paid pilot or Dedicated commitment within 60 days of sandbox expiry, we apply a one-time conversion credit of $1,250 against first invoice.

I’ve attached a draft SOW with the integration checklist they need to complete. If Rishi okays, I’ll send the DocuSign and the credits allocation.

— Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Finance: we should tag the credits as "promotional sandbox" in billing so they never auto-convert to credits on an invoice.
- Security: ask Elena to provide the high-level data flow doc and a list of endpoints to be tested — we can pre-provision a sandbox cluster with monitoring enabled.
- Legal: simple one-paragraph addendum (no change to existing T&Cs) + DocuSign signature. I can loop Legal if you want, but for a one-off $2.5k it's usually handled by Deal Desk + Sales Ops.

If Rishi gives the go-ahead, I'll draft the DocuSign and coordinate with Finance to reserve the credits.

— Marissa
